# Assure Fintech

> Independent information about Indian credit cards and personal finance. Card terms change; confirm fees, rewards, caps, exclusions and availability with the issuer before applying or paying.

Updated September 26, 2026. The catalogue contains 76 card records. A source link and review date do not guarantee that every product term remains current. Records awaiting review are labelled accordingly. Calculators provide category-level illustrations, not transaction-level reward guarantees: merchant codes, payment routes, statement cycles, redemption choices and account-specific offers can change the result.

## Start here

- [Card catalogue](https://www.assurefintech.com/cards)
- [Comparison guides](https://www.assurefintech.com/compare)
- [Best-card guides](https://www.assurefintech.com/best)
- [Blog](https://www.assurefintech.com/blog)
- [Editorial policy](https://www.assurefintech.com/editorial-policy)
- [What changed](https://www.assurefintech.com/whats-changed)

## Important limitations

- Do not assume a headline cashback rate applies to rent, insurance, fuel, utilities, wallet loads or all online purchases.
- Rewards may be capped by category and by statement or calendar month.
- A points rate is not a cash rate; redemption value can vary.
- Check the issuer's current product page and terms before relying on any card recommendation.
- This website is not a bank or financial adviser and may receive referral compensation.
